text:
rupert: Heads-up — after last night's v2 default flip, a handful of tenants saw a cost uptick on embeddings background jobs. Need emergency guardrails in console.
nika: saw it too, spike around 03:05 UTC; mainly long-running batch embeddings not interactive requests.
jamal: root cause guess: v2 does async re-encoding that uses larger chunking + no batching squash for offline jobs -> token count balloon.
claire: can we detect background-job user-agents and force fallback or throttle by token-cost?
rupert: yes. proposal: 1) add a 'cost-preview' column per-route in console that simulates expected token delta for common workloads (single request, batch-100, batch-1000). 2) add per-route 'dry-run' toggle that routes to v2 but bills/telemetry marked as preview (no real fallback) — safe for QA.
jamal: dry-run is helpful. We need a runtime knob to apply token-rate-limit for routes flagged as 'offline' so they can't blow budget.
nika: telemetry ask: emit 'projected_token_delta' and 'routing_preview=true' tag. Also histogram of seq_len by route.
devops-bot: auto: alert annotated: affected_routes=3, avg_seq_len_p90=512, est_token_increase=+1.1M/day
sylvie: UX: quick path to exclude 'background' UA from implicit-route auto-swap. Maybe a console rule: "exclude patterns" for UA regex.
claire: also add a per-tenant 'max-token-velocity' hard cap that triggers automatic revert to pinned version when exceeded.
rupert: for immediate mitigation: create a temporary 'soft quota' on embeddings-per-hour for the affected tenants and flip their route to v1 via API. Jamal, can you draft the API call?
jamal: sure. example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/tenant/route_override \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tenant":"coreai","override":{"version":"v1","ttl":"6h","reason":"embeddings-batch-cost-surge"}}'
```
nika: add to runbook: how to set 'max-token-velocity' via UI and via CLI, and steps to enable dry-run per-route.
sylvie: ops concern: if we flip routes for batch jobs, cached embeddings might be inconsistent; add note to background-job SDK to treat stale cache and rehydrate safely.
rupert: I will update the rollout checklist and ping legal if any billing adjustments needed. Claire can you mock the cost-preview UI? sylvie please add the UA regex exclusion UI flow.
claire: on it, will post a design by lunchtime.
devops-bot: auto: follow-up scheduled in 30m. jamal: will prepare runbook snippets and a short rollback playbook.
jamal: will also add alert to fire if projected_token_delta > $150/day for any tenant.
nika: thanks all — let's converge on console changes in this sprint and make 'dry-run' GA gated behind an org flag.
rupert: agreed. action items: jamal->runbook+api examples; claire->UI mocks; sylvie->SDK guidance; nika->telemetry tags + alerts; rupert->comm to customer-ops.
